text: Steenbarger: nothing answers it yet. The FROG trigger h1_close_above:bar_high stands ACT_NOW with no volume clause at day_vol 0.88, under 1.40 (C16); close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.96 is my 5.1-10% late zone (C17); div_bear_count 4 is a distribution read (C25). Minervini's WAIT trigger (tight pause, hourly close above the 52-week closing high on 1.4x volume) would answer the volume and late-buy points, and I back it. It does not answer mine: rs_leadership LAGGARD, rs_down_day_20d -3.16 fails my L test (R2). I hold OPPOSE until rs_leadership reads LEADER and a pivot breaks on 1.4x volume.
